Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Geb wrote:
> if a minion uses the manuver of a weapon he must strike with it, but
> if what about his additional strikes?, they must be from weapon too?

Explicitly answered in [6.4.3 p.38] of the rulebook: "For additional
strikes, any strike can be chosen, even if a maneuver had been used."
